reviews.title: Good but limited
reviews.text: It has a bit of a learning curve but it was worth the five bucks to be able to make a simple backyard layout to plan a future move. While the textures are especially abundant and detailed, the objects themselves are limited and basic. Certain items can be substituted for other ones if you are creative enough but it is not ideal. There have been very few updates over the past couple of years to this app the developer is clearly focused on the much more expensive subscription home design app and will probably never even bother to update this one again. The app is functional as it is but don’t expect any improvements from this profit driven developer.
